dial.summary: 4/8 indicators supportive on November 17 — Global M2 at $104.3T (Sep 2026, Oct data pending), ISM Manufacturing at 55.5 (10th straight expansion month), Fed Balance Sheet flat at $6.76T, and BTC perp funding near zero/slightly negative signal a deleveraged market in classic accumulation conditions; DXY at 103.50 (above 100 threshold) remains the primary macro headwind ahead of the Nov 18 FOMC minutes, Nov 25 Oct PCE, Dec 1 ISM, and Dec 9 FOMC decision.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 aggregate (US/Euro Zone/China/Japan) at ~$104.3T as of September 2026 (104,317.08B per MacroMicro series); October G4 data not yet published as of November 17, 2026 — typically updated mid-to-late November following the reference month; broader global M2 estimates: Bitrue $103.66T (Aug), Au79 Macro $103.89T (wider aggregates); US M2 $23.41T in Sep 2026 (+5.7% YoY per FRED H.6, next release Nov 24); 4-week Aug→Sep G4 change: +$0.64T (+0.6%), above flat threshold — trend UP; status supportive (4-week G4 trend up, no YoY contraction); held unchanged pending October G4 publication.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2, 2026), beating consensus 54.7%, up 1.0pp from September's 54.5%; 10th consecutive expansion month; Production sub-index 59.0 (highest since Nov 2021), New Orders 55.5, Employment 52.4; Prices Paid 75.2 (down from Sep's 77.9, still elevated); 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); status supportive (above 50 and rising); Trading Economics consensus for November (Dec 1 release): 55.5; next ISM Manufacturing release December 1, 2026; held unchanged — October 55.5 is the current monthly reading.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot ~103.50 as of November 17, 2026 (Trading Economics: 103.53–103.55; FXStreet: ~103.50 intraday; prior close Nov 16: 103.42, up ~0.08 on the day); 4-week trend UP — from ~101.5–101.8 on October 14 to ~103.50 on November 17, net +~1.7–2.0%, well above the 0.5% flat threshold; hot October CPI (+0.4% MoM, Nov 10), hawkish Fed repricing, and strong October retail sales all drove DXY higher; status headwind (DXY above 100 — must fall below 97.5 for supportive); FRED DTWEXBGS network-restricted — ICE spot corroborated via Trading Economics and FXStreet.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.86% on November 12, 2026 (Macrotrends and yourbestsavings.com confirm; latest available — Nov 13 was no print, Nov 14–15 weekend, Nov 17 print pending); secondary source thetrading.tools reports Nov 9: 2.66% then trending higher to Nov 12 2.86%; 4-week trend FLAT — from approximately 2.85–2.90% on October 14 to 2.86% on November 12, net change ~0 to -4bps within flat threshold; status neutral (above 2% but flat — headwind requires BOTH rising trend AND above 2%); 52-week range approximately 1.72%–2.95%; held at 2.86% pending Nov 17 DFII10 print.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: 2s10s spread at approximately +24–27bps as of November 10–13, 2026 (YieldCurve.pro: +25bps Nov 10, down 7bps on day; stockmarketwatch: +27bps Nov 13; SOFR Rate: +24bps Nov 13; meaterm.com: +35bps Nov 6); 4-week trend FLAT — from approximately +28–32bps on October 14 to +25bps range Nov 10–13, net change approximately -3 to -7bps within flat threshold; 52-week range 20 to 74bps per YieldCurve.pro; status neutral (positive spread, no sustained steepening, not deeply inverted — headwind requires < -50bps); FOMC blackout period begins ~November 29 ahead of December 9 decision.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL: $6,758,867M ($6.759T) for week ended November 11, 2026 (H.4.1 released November 12, 2026; +$10,722M WoW from Nov 4's $6,748,145M; +$178,405M YoY); 247wallst.com (Nov 8): balance sheet growing again at $6.75T; prior weekly readings: Nov 4 $6,748,145M, Oct 28 $6,745,635M, Oct 14 $6,755,639M; 4-week change Oct 14 → Nov 11: +$3,228M (~+$3.2B, essentially flat); YoY +$178.4B (+2.7%); status supportive (flat with slight YoY growth, no aggressive QT); next H.4.1 release November 19, 2026 (covering week ended November 18); value held pending that release.

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC perp funding near zero/slightly negative as of November 16–17, 2026; CoinGlass OI-weighted rate was -0.0004% per 8h on Nov 16 (flipped negative); exchange-level reads: Binance -0.0022% (CoinGabbar Nov 16), several exchanges negative; broader aggregates: BigGo Finance Nov 15: 0.0020%, CoinGlass aggregate Nov 15: 0.0029%, Au79 Macro Nov 16: 0.0079% (wider aggregation); CoinGlass site network-restricted in this environment — values from secondary sources; 30-day trend FLAT — mid-October rates near zero/slightly negative, no sustained directional move; status supportive (well below 0.04% headwind; near-zero/negative funding in an Extreme Fear environment is a textbook accumulation signal); value held at -0.0004% pending live CoinGlass feed.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$284.952B as of November 16, 2026 (DefiLlama; USDT $175.344B, USDT dominance within stables ~61.53%); total crypto market cap ~$2.31–2.34T (CoinGecko-sourced Nov 16 estimates); implied stablecoin dominance ~12.3% ($284.952B / $2.31T); 30-day trend UP — October 14 dominance ~10.5–10.8%, November 16–17 ~12.3%, net +~1.5–1.8pp; status neutral — headwind requires rising dominance AND rising TOTAL simultaneously; TOTAL has contracted from ~$2.6T (Oct 14) to ~$2.31T so headwind condition not met; supportive condition (falling 30-day dominance) also not met; rising dominance reflects risk-off repositioning during BTC pullback; CoinGecko site network-restricted, using secondary sources.

upcoming.title: Housing Starts (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Census Bureau releases October 2026 New Residential Construction at 8:30 AM ET; elevated mortgage rates (30Y near 7.1%) and real yields at 2.86% continue to pressure housing affordability; a sharp drop in permits would underscore the housing drag on Q4 2026 growth ahead of the Nov 25 PCE print and Dec 9 FOMC decision.

upcoming.title: FOMC Minutes — October 27–28 Meeting
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve releases minutes of the October 27–28 FOMC meeting at 2:00 PM ET; the Fed held at 3.75%–4.00% at that meeting; minutes will reveal member views on the December 9 hike threshold, particularly given both October CPI (+0.4% MoM, Nov 10) and October PPI (Nov 13) arrived after the October meeting; markets will read the minutes against the new inflation reality; FOMC blackout period begins ~November 29 ahead of the December 9 decision.

upcoming.title: Pending Home Sales (October 2026)
upcoming.note: NAR releases October 2026 Pending Home Sales Index; leading indicator of existing home sales with a 1–2 month lag; elevated mortgage rates near 7.1% and real yields at 2.86% are suppressing contract signings; a persistent decline below prior-year levels would confirm housing as a sustained drag on Q4 2026 economic activity.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended November 15, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL releases weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET; key weekly labor read ahead of the Thanksgiving-week data lull and the ~November 29 FOMC blackout period; a sustained trend above 220K would add dovish counter-pressure to the December 9 hike case; next NFP release December 4 (November data), arriving just 5 days before the December 9 FOMC decision.

upcoming.title: Philadelphia Fed Manufacturing Index (November 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia releases November 2026 Manufacturing Business Outlook Survey at 8:30 AM ET; first-look at November manufacturing activity ahead of the December 1 ISM Manufacturing PMI; a positive print above 0 would reinforce the October ISM signal at 55.5; released on the third Thursday of the month, same day as jobless claims.

upcoming.title: S&P Global Flash PMIs (November 2026)
upcoming.note: S&P Global releases flash estimates for US Manufacturing and Services PMIs for November 2026 at 9:45 AM ET; first real-time read on November business activity ahead of the December 1 ISM Manufacturing PMI; a Services print above 55 would reinforce the sticky-inflation narrative heading into the December 9 FOMC decision; ISM Manufacturing has been at 55.5 for October (10th straight expansion); Euro area flash PMIs also released same morning.

upcoming.title: Conference Board Consumer Confidence (November 2026)
upcoming.note: Conference Board releases November 2026 Consumer Confidence Index at 10:00 AM ET; released last Tuesday of each month; tracks consumer sentiment on current conditions and 6-month expectations; a deterioration from October's level would signal cracks in the consumer spending backdrop ahead of the November 25 PCE release; expectations sub-index is a leading indicator for future consumption and GDP.
